_doc: Candidate future detector volumes not yet integrated into detector_lz_v2.json. These are kept as reference for later hierarchy work (ICV_void, LXe container, PMT placement, insulation source modelling). The entries below intentionally preserve the original source block and are not guaranteed to match the active V2 schema yet.

volumes._doc: TPC Teflon walls (FCPT): R=[72.8, 73.947], z=[-13.75, 145.6], center z=65.925; t=1.147 cm back-derived from 184 kg / (rho_PTFE x 2pi x R x H). Real LZ panels are 5 mm thick; the smearing here is to keep the slab self-shielding integral correct at the same total mass.
volumes.name: FCPT

volumes._doc: MLI cryostat insulation: thin blanket on ICV body outer wall, mass=13.8 kg. R_inner=83.0 (= ICV outer), z follows ICV body extent z=[-41.33, 148.5]. Treated as zero-thickness PSurface in the MC; here drawn as 1 cm shell (rho_eff ~0.14 g/cm^3 - MLI blanket bulk density). Adjust thickness to taste; the mass is the only physically anchored quantity.
volumes.name: MLI

volumes.name: PMT_TOP_PMTs

notes: shape: PMT TOP/BOT components use 'cylinder' (a thin filled disc-like volume), not 'cylinder_shell', because the source is a flat-disc PSurfaceDisc that fills the full circle r in [0, R]. The thicknesses are back-derived from mass to give the same rho x V -> mass invariant, but in the actual MC these are zero-thickness surface sources with no self-shielding.
MLI thickness is a free parameter. The MC treats it as a zero-thickness PSurface, so the only physical anchor is the 13.8 kg mass and the attachment to the ICV body outer wall (R = 83.0).
PMT_TOP_PMTs and PMT_TOP_bases overlap radially with PMT_TOP_structure but occupy different z-bands.
PMT_BOT_R8778_dome and PMT_BARREL_R8778_lower use simplified positions (R = 72.8 / 74.3 instead of the actual R = 81.4 cm at the ICV inner wall).
Activity numbers are not included here. They should be sourced later from the relevant assay tables.
